mentions.name: Excel VBA Spreadsheet Framework
mentions.description: A framework for Excel spreadsheets written in Excel VBA. Distributed as a single small Excel file, it radically changes the Excel UX by leveraging the object model exposed to VBA.
mentions.source_excerpt: A framework for Excel spreadsheets, written in Excel VBA. A nine-minute demo video is here: https://www.cabin.wtf (the file is 4mb, not 4kb)
